# config

```go
import "github.com/shdeen/bildomat/internal/provider/config"
```

Package config embeds the descriptor\-class provider configurations: the providers served entirely by the shared request code in internal/provider, each declared by one JSON document named after its ID and nothing else.

## Index

- [Constants](<#constants>)
- [Variables](<#variables>)


## Constants

<a name="IDOpenAI"></a>The descriptor\-class provider IDs. Each names its configuration file, \<ID\>.json.

```go
const (
    IDOpenAI     = "openai"
    IDXAI        = "xai"
    IDOpenRouter = "openrouter"
    IDRecraft    = "recraft"
)
```

## Variables

<a name="JSONOpenAI"></a>The embedded configuration documents, one per descriptor\-class provider.

```go
var (
    //go:embed openai.json
    JSONOpenAI []byte

    //go:embed xai.json
    JSONXAI []byte

    //go:embed openrouter.json
    JSONOpenRouter []byte

    //go:embed recraft.json
    JSONRecraft []byte
)
```
